% pgnx translation of argslist.txt (pgn-extract's -A argsfile for the C
% test target test-AA), in pgnx's own argument-file grammar (MIGRATION.md,
% "Argument files"): ":-X" lines become flags, the ":-t" section one --tag
% line per criterion, ":-f gamefiles.txt" the files it listed. Paths are
% relative to the working directory, which the conformance test sets to a
% directory holding copies of the input files.
% Strip variations.
--no-variations
% Silent mode
--quiet
% Duplicates file.
--duplicates test-AA-dupes.pgn
% Unique file.
--output test-AA-unique.pgn
% Tag criteria
--tag White "Fischer"
--tag Black "Petrosian"
% The game files (gamefiles.txt).
fischer.pgn
petrosian.pgn
